title: Is it Still Fair? A Comparative Evaluation of Fairness Algorithms through the Lens of Covariate Drift
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical evaluation of algorithmic fairness metrics (such as statistical parity and equalized odds) under data distributional drift. While fairness is a core ethical principle in AI, the study is a mathematical analysis of traditional machine learning models and does not evaluate religious, theological, or philosophical moral systems.
